title: 5 signs your current systems are holding back your company's growth

points.heading: 1. Adding a person doesn't add capacity
points.body: In a healthy operation, hiring someone increases what you can handle.

points.heading: 2. One person is a single point of failure
points.body: Ask yourself: if someone in operations took two weeks off with no laptop, what would stop working?

points.heading: 3. Reporting takes days and nobody fully trusts the numbers
points.body: If getting a straight answer to "how are we doing this month?" means someone manually combining four spreadsheets, cross-checking totals and still saying "roughly" — you're flying without i…

cta.sub: Five signals your business has outgrown its current systems — from single points of failure to admin growing faster than revenue — and what they cost.
